followUps.title: Follow-ups
followUps.intro: Every open follow-up on a lead, with the customer's last WhatsApp message. When one comes due, the AI writes to the customer if WhatsApp's 24-hour window is open; the follow-up stays here for your call.

empty.due: Nothing due. Follow-ups due today and overdue show here.

ai.window_closed: AI didn't write ({ago} ago): the 24-hour window was closed. Send a template or call.
ai.no_chat: AI didn't write ({ago} ago): this customer has no WhatsApp chat.
ai.opted_out: AI didn't write ({ago} ago): the customer asked us to stop.
ai.off: AI didn't write ({ago} ago): the AI isn't answering this chat.
ai.failed: AI couldn't write ({ago} ago). Follow up yourself.

editDialog.title: Edit follow-up
editDialog.description: Change what to do or when. Moved to a later time, the AI writes again then.

problems.title: Say what to do.
problems.required: Say what to do, and choose a day and a time.

snooze.title: Snooze
snooze.description: When should this come back? When it was first due stays on record.

problems.required: Choose a day and a time.
